controls.capDescription: The Aave ACL Admin executor holds GHO's default-admin, facilitator-manager, and bucket-manager roles and can authorize facilitators or raise their bucket capacities.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530270, hasRole() returned true for 0x5300A1a1 under DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, FACILITATOR_MANAGER_ROLE, and BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE. getFacilitatorsList() returned the six facilitator contracts represented below.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530270, the verified non-proxy GHO token had zero EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots. Aave's ACL Admin executor held all three GHO administrative roles, and getFacilitatorsList() returned six cap-limited facilitator contracts. Contract-governed minting requires no off-chain reserve reconciliation; no mint-authority incident is recorded in the reviewed protocol sources. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: six facilitators mint only within DAO-managed buckets and Aave governance can add facilitators or raise buckets, while GHO is a protocol liability without an off-chain reserve claim or prudential supervisor.
